## Recent work: Implemented bounded webhook retries in `ledgerly/webhooks.py`: configurable `max_attempts` (default 3), exponential capped backoff, transport/server-error retries, and immediate propagation of client errors and exhausted exceptions. Added tests in `tests/test_webhooks.py`; the focused suite has 8 passing tests, full suite has 44 passing tests, and Ruff/diff checks pass. The requested production webhook v2 cutover/replay commands have not been run.

Baseline for search indexing was established with `pytest -q tests/search/test_index.py`: 18 passed and 2 failed because rebuilt documents omitted recently updated invoice descriptions. This likely informs upcoming route-splitting work if search behavior is involved.

The router split is paused; webhook retry and “Webhook v1 to v2 cutover” work are also paused side tasks. Do not retry the Celery visibility-timeout change. ## Recent work: Search rebuild performance was optimized by tenant-scoping invoice queries, using bounded concurrent embedding requests, chunking batches at 100 documents, and sharing the embedding client with the management command. Rebuild benchmarking improved from a 16.73-second local median to 2.41 seconds for 10,000 documents. Added transactional bulk vector upserts and migration `0042_add_search_vector_tenant_document.py` for a unique `(tenant_id, document_id)` index. Relevant suites passed: search index/rebuilder 33 tests, search storage 12, management rebuild 9, and the full suite 247 passed, 4 skipped. CSV export reproduction remains unresolved: `tests/test_csv_export.py` had 1 failure and 6 passes; `ledgerly/exporters/csv_export.py` opens report files without an explicit encoding, while the test expects UTF-8. A production webhook health check for cutover `20250308` returned v2 healthy.
